notes:
v1.4.1 Release:
- New: Dub Whole Series (under Join Episodes / Split Movie). Pick the episodes folder, set minutes per part and per tab, and press Start. Each part is joined, split into tabs, transcribed, voiced and has its background music isolated in one run
- After exporting a part, press Next part to do the same for the next one
- Stop any time. Continue picks up at the step that stopped, even after a quota pause, an error or an app restart
- Includes everything from v1.4.0: consistent character and place names across parts, one All Tabs menu, smarter API key switching and a safer Gemini connection
